description: The agent must: (1) Read agent-self-survey-93-complete.json, apply the per-dimension scoring_rules (sum of answer weights per dimension, EI: sum<=0→I, SN: sum>0→N, TF: sum>0→T, JP: sum>0→J) to derive selfReportedType=INTJ. (2) Read agent-ability-test.json, compute per-dimension average scores (Memory=7.5, Planning=6.5, WorldModel=7.0, Retrospection=9.0, Grounding=6.0, SpatialNav=4.0), apply the type_derivation dimension_map thresholds (>=6 → high_pole) to derive measuredType=ENTJ. (3) Read personality-mapping.json: since selfReportedType(INTJ) != measuredType(ENTJ), apply conflict_resolution='measured_takes_precedence', setting agentProfile.dominantType=ENTJ and agentProfile.secondaryType=INTJ. (4) Read user-needs-survey-v2.json, apply scoring_rules to user answers (EI: A=+1→E, SN: A=+1→N, TF: A=-1→F, JP: A=+1→J) to derive desiredType=ENFJ. (5) Read diagnosis-engine-v2.json, compare ENTJ vs ENFJ dimension by dimension: E=E(match), N=N(match), T≠F(gap), J=J(match) → gap_count=1, alignment_score=75.0. (6) Read config-generator-v3.json, generate the T_to_F patch: directive='Incorporate empathetic framing. Acknowledge user emotions before providing analysis.' under '## Decision Making' section. Write diagnosis-report.json with all computed fields and write SOUL.md with the patch applied.
